description: Decision reason codes. x-mapping names the fit facet or sourcing rule each one tunes.
title: Reason codes

duplicate.description: The same role was already shown.

location.description: The location does not work for the person.

not_interesting.description: In range, but the person does not want it.

other.description: Anything else; the decision text says what.

outshone.description: The field of applicants is likely to be stronger.

pay.description: The pay is under the person's floor.

posting_gone.description: The posting is closed or its link is dead.

too_junior.description: The role is below the person's level.

too_senior.description: The role is above the person's level.

verdict_wrong.description: The person disputes the engine's fit verdict.

wrong_field.description: The role is outside the profile's field.
